extraction.Name: Ruth Josephine Smith
extraction.Buyer: W. H. Tackett; consideration was to be $2400.00 and to be paid when an abstract could be had showing clear title; Tackett wired the Farmers State Bank of Kilgore that there was a draft on the way and it was not to be paid until the abstract was received showing clear title
extraction.NOTES: Document is an affidavit sworn by William J. Bordeaux, age 44, not by the allottee Ruth Josephine Smith. Bordeaux states he worked for W. H. Tackett and acted as Tackett's agent in the purchase of Smith's allotment. Smith signed the deed on the day of the transaction but was not to receive money until the abstract was sent to the Farmers State Bank of Kilgore showing clear title. A week or ten days later, Smith told Bordeaux she had received her money. Affidavit references a prior affidavit by Ruth Josephine Smith dated April 4, 1929. Subscribed and sworn before S. W. Cross, Notary Public (commission expires 4-28-32), on June 17, 1929.
